title: A Letter for the Verdict
author: Astrid Villalobos
blurb: Dominic Okonkwo, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
